title: Client Services Schedule for Settlement Agreements: Approval Response, Validity and Resubmission Figures
content:
# Settlement Agreements — Client Approval Figures by Programme

Where an offer under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements needs the placing client's approval, four programme figures govern the approval request: the business days the client has to answer, the calendar days after an approval within which the approved offer must be issued, the further requests allowed on one account after a decline in rolling 12 months, and the calendar days after a declined approval before another request on the account.

| Figure | Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement | Lump-Sum Settlement | Two-Payment Settlement | Three-Payment Settlement | Six-Payment Settlement | Hardship Settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Client response due (business days) | 0 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 5 |
| Approval validity (calendar days after the approval) | 0 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 0 | 15 |
| Further requests allowed after a decline in rolling 12 months | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| Wait after a declined approval (calendar days) | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 0 | 30 |

## Reading the figures

- A client response figure of 0 and an approval validity of 0 mark a programme where approval requests are not available: the Prompt-Pay Discount Settlement and the Six-Payment Settlement.
- The Hardship Settlement gives the client the longest time to answer, 5 business days, and keeps an approval valid the longest, 15 calendar days.

## Hypothetical comparison

For a hypothetical approval granted on a given day, an approved Three-Payment offer must be issued within the 10 calendar days that follow, and an approved Hardship Settlement offer within the 15 that follow.
